title: Coordination engineering of Ru–N-C based OER catalysts guided by the ΔG*OH descriptor: a theoretical study
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00481D, Paper
Xiaoming Zhang, Suli Wang, Shansheng Yu, Gongquan Sun
A ΔG*OH guided framework maps the activity-stability landscape of Ru–N–C OER catalysts. Ru–NiN4 and RuIr–O3R emerge as top candidates, while operando simulations reveal *O-induced destabilization as the key durability bottleneck.
